capabilities: Assign custom statuses to notes via status bar, editor toolbar, context menus, or commands
Show status icons and hover overviews in the file explorer
Create custom status templates with YAML frontmatter key mappings
View vault-wide status dashboards and grouped status views
Store statuses for non-Markdown files in a synced JSON store
extras: Dashboards and grouped views are gated behind experimental toggles and a vault size limit. The plugin includes a community template marketplace where users submit templates via pull request to the official repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a per-file workflow status (draft, review, done, etc.) consistently across Markdown and non-Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Works with Dataview, Templater, QuickAdd, and search.
